about.note: Rockstar Games and Sony have not officially published this trophy list. The names, descriptions and grades below are as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on all 55), cross-checked against Push Square, Insider Gaming and GameMapa. Five hidden trophies are still unsolved — their entries say so instead of guessing. There are no online trophies: all 55 are single-player.
about.platinum_plan: About 200 hours in a single playthrough; PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 (via GameMapa). Stage 1: story, 60-80 hours. Stage 2: the 100% Completion checklist, about 100 hours. Stage 3: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup, about 10 hours.
about.title: GTA VI trophy guide and tracker — PlayStation 5

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Expect about 200 hours in one playthrough — PowerPyx rates the whole hunt 4 out of 10 for difficulty, and the hardest single trophy is A Long Road for 100% completion.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening story mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks as part of the story and cannot be missed — just play through the start of the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. A story trophy: unmissable, it pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. A story trophy: unmissable, it pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. A story trophy: unmissable, it pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. A story trophy: unmissable, it pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. After it, free roam stays open, so you can keep exploring Leonida and mop up everything else — the real work toward 100% starts here.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. A story trophy: unmissable, it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. A story trophy: unmissable, it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play, a Chapter 4 mission. A story trophy: unmissable, it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission. A story trophy: unmissable, it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission. A story trophy: unmissable, it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission. A story trophy: unmissable, it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion. The checklist appears after the story under Progress, and you can check it any time at Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion. You need almost everything — for example 15 of the 18 Collectible Card sets and 70 of the 80 Challenges — but not literally everything, so follow the in-game checklist rather than doing every last thing.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida: Stunt Jumps (130 in the game), Under the Bridges (202), Knife Flights (40) and Base Jumps (25). That is a little over half of them, so pick the easy ones. Find discovered stunt spots at Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots, and track progress at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Activities, then Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything for this one.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Two ranges are named in the guides: Rodgers Ranch and Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn, and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — find them at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to clear, and some stay locked until you meet other conditions shown on the map.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Find the locations you have discovered at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 in the game — winning the same race again does not count. Track them at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Racing. Most race locations let you hire a car; if you use your own, watch its Rating, which Mod Shop upgrades can raise.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Early in the game Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg; fish in the area marked on your map until you land one big enough. You need a boat with a fishing rod — plenty can be borrowed in the area if you do not own one. His questline starts in Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any arcade game. There are 4 video games in the game, and three of them are on the TV at home, so this is one of the easiest trophies — sit down and finish one.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Andy's story missions — 5 quests, Lucia only, starting in Chapter 3. The trophy pops after the last one.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission, named Maritime Disputes. Kenton's strand is clearing 7 shipwrecks, starting in Chapter 1 — work through them and the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission, named Hometown Heroes. Billy's strand is 5 quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, starting in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers and Freaks mission strands across Leonida. The 100% Completion checklist does not ask for these quests, so they are usually what is left after the checklist is done — save them for the final cleanup stage.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission after delivering all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List, starting in Chapter 3. The trophy pops once the last delivery strand is done.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission — destroy the labs and complete his last quest. Jason only, starting in Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots across Leonida. THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: after an early Chapter 1 mission, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning and heads out to the balcony — follow her, accept the prompt, and she shows you how it works. You cannot do that first meditation again after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it while you can. A meditation only counts once its final zen animation has played. Track progress at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, Jason only. The exact animal is still being confirmed by the guides, so check the current PowerPyx or GameMapa page before you set out — do not waste time on the wrong hunt.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets. Cards you have collected can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward your progress. Track sets at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. Going for 100% needs 15 sets, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app on Jason or Lucia's phone (hold Up to open it): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Scan every new landmark as you pass it during the story and the count builds up on its own. Track it at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges in the game; 70 are needed for 100% Completion, so you can skip the nastiest 10. View every Challenge and its requirement at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. It often pops by itself, because robbing a bank vault instantly gives you a 4-star Wanted Level. One escape route the guides name is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: police struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you, and the trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well for this. The trophy is delayed and pops about half a minute after you leave the third store, so do not panic if it does not pop at once.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — getting inside one, or scanning it with the WAiNK app, counts as a discovery. It should happen naturally across a story playthrough. Track discovered vehicles at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Prepare first: buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick gang members at their illegal operations.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner at Vice City International Airport and fly away with it. The easiest airliner is docked at terminals E3/E4, and the trophy unlocks once you are 1 km away from the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a tank — the guides place one at Mile Zero Air Station — and survive what follows. The description is a joke about the Rhino tank and the heat it brings, so expect a heavy police response and have an escape route in mind.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The guides note this needs the Snap Gun from Chapter 3, so do not attempt it before then — plan it for the post-story cleanup if you missed the window.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults in the game and escape each time. Vault robberies instantly raise you to a 4-star Wanted Level, which is also how Hot Together usually pops.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. It counts toward 100% Completion too, so it usually pops while you work through the checklist.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. Drive, fly and walk into every corner of the state; the map fills in as you go, and the trophy pops when no fog is left.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — 39 such operations exist across Leonida. It counts toward 100% Completion, so it usually pops while you work through the checklist.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNSOLVED — no confirmed method yet. trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and lose the police. The description's bowling joke is a cover for a robbery: get in, take the valuables, and break away clean.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Go to the gym together: while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. These are the small choices and crimes that shift your profile as you play, so the count builds up across normal play — keep playing and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNSOLVED — no confirmed method yet. The description hints at a second attempt, but PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown and GameMapa notes the exact trigger is still unknown. This guide will not invent steps: check the current PowerPyx or GameMapa page once the community cracks it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: UNSOLVED — no confirmed method yet. The description hints at something strange, but PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown and GameMapa notes the exact trigger is still unknown. This guide will not invent steps: check the current PowerPyx or GameMapa page once the community cracks it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNSOLVED — no confirmed method yet. The description points to knocking someone down with a melee drive-by, but PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown and GameMapa notes the exact trigger is still unknown. This guide will not invent steps: check the current PowerPyx or GameMapa page once the community cracks it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — the fences who take them. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, so the total builds up as you work through the robbery trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Big purchases count fastest — vehicles, weapons and property upgrades all add up, and the total is cumulative across the whole game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties, $160,000 in total. Save up during the story and buy them in the post-story cleanup stage, when money is easier to come by.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register cars you find as you explore — it pairs naturally with Whip It Good, which asks you to discover 100 vehicles.
trophies.name: On the Spot
